title: USC's Alex Graham and Luke Wafle named to freshman of the year award watch list
text:
USC’s Alex Graham and Luke Wafle named to freshman of the year award watch list
LAX Leader
USC redshirt freshman safety Alex Graham and true freshman defensive end Luke Wafle have been named to the 2026 Shaun Alexander Freshman of the Year Award Watch List, according to an Aug. 26 announcement. The award recognizes the outstanding freshman player in college football.
Graham recorded 15 tackles, including two for loss of five yards, while appearing in five games with two starts as a true freshman cornerback in 2025. He tallied seven tackles, including one for loss of two yards, against UCLA and had a single-game career-high eight tackles, including one for loss of three yards, in the Alamo Bowl versus TCU. Graham was sidelined at the beginning of last season due to injury.
A four-star recruit from Michigan, Graham was rated among the top players in his state by several recruiting services and contributed on offense, defense, and special teams during high school. In 2024 he helped Cass Tech achieve a 12-2 record and secure multiple championships, including the Detroit Public School League Blue City Championship and Division 1 State Championship. He earned recognition on various all-state teams that year.
Wafle enrolled at USC in spring 2026 after graduating early from high school. As a five-star recruit ranked as the No. 1 player nationally by On3/Rivals and highly rated by other major outlets, he was invited to participate in prestigious events such as the Navy All-American Bowl, where he earned MVP honors. During his senior season at Hun School in New Jersey, Wafle recorded 99 tackles with a school-record 23 sacks and led his team to an undefeated season and New England Championship.
The Shaun Alexander Freshman of the Year Award will be presented at the Maxwell Football Club Awards on March 13, 2027, at Coca Cola Roxy Theater in Atlanta.
